articles.title: How to Solve AI's Inequality Problem
articles.topic: 数字经济发展成果应更均衡分配；AI 技术与财富过度集中于少数城市会加剧不均，作者建议重新定义 AI 技术的作用
articles.source: 2024 年考研英语（二）Text 1 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: In her new book Cogs and Monsters: What Economics Is, and What It Should Be, Diane Coyle, an economist at Cambridge University, argues that the digital economy requires new ways of thinking about progress.
sentences.cn: 剑桥大学经济学家戴安娜·科伊尔在她的新书《齿轮与怪物：经济学是什么，它应该是什么》中认为，数字经济需要人们对进步有新的思考方式。

sentences.en: "Whatever we mean by the economy growing, by things getting better, the gains will have to be more evenly shared than in the recent past," she writes.
sentences.cn: “无论我们所说的经济增长、情况好转意味着什么，收益都将必须比不久前被更加均衡地分配。”她写道。

sentences.en: "An economy of tech millionaires or billionaires and gig workers, with middle-income jobs undercut by automation, will not be politically sustainable."
sentences.cn: “一个由科技百万富翁或亿万富翁和零工组成、中等收入的工作被自动化削弱的经济体，在政治上是无法持续的。”

sentences.en: Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people will require greater use of digital technologies to boost productivity in various sectors, including health care and construction, says Coyle.
sentences.cn: 科伊尔称，提高生活水平并促进繁荣发展，使更多人从中受益，需要更多地使用数字技术来提高包括医疗保健和建筑在内的各个领域的生产效率。

words.meaning: n. 领域，行业（sector 的复数）

sentences.en: But people can't be expected to embrace the changes if they're not seeing the benefits—if they're just seeing good jobs being destroyed.
sentences.cn: 但是，如果人们没有看到好处——如果他们只是看到好工作被毁掉，就不能指望人们会欣然接受这些变化。

words.meaning: v. 摧毁，毁掉（destroy 的过去分词）

sentences.en: In a recent interview, Coyle said she fears that tech's inequality problem could be a roadblock to deploying AI.
sentences.cn: 在最近的一次采访中，科伊尔表示，她担心科技带来的不均衡问题可能会成为有效运用人工智能的障碍。

words.meaning: v. 部署，有效运用（deploy 的现在分词）

sentences.en: "We're talking about disruption," she says. "These are transformative technologies that change the ways we spend our time every day, that change business models that succeed."
sentences.cn: “我们正在谈论颠覆性的变革。”她说。“这些变革性技术改变了我们每天花费时间的方式，改变了成功的商业模式。”

words.meaning: adj. 变革性的，引起巨变的

sentences.en: To make such "tremendous changes," she adds, you need social buy-in.
sentences.cn: 她补充说，要做出如此“巨大的改变”，你需要社会的认同。

sentences.en: Instead, says Coyle, resentment is simmering among many as the benefits are perceived to go to elites in a handful of prosperous cities.
sentences.cn: 而现实情况正相反，科伊尔说，许多人心中正充斥着不满情绪，因为他们认为好处为少数几个繁荣城市的精英阶层所享有。

sentences.en: According to the Brookings Institution, a short list of eight American cities that included San Francisco, San Jose, Boston, and Seattle had roughly 38% of all tech jobs by 2019.
sentences.cn: 布鲁金斯学会的数据显示，截至2019年，包括旧金山、圣何塞、波士顿和西雅图在内的8个美国城市的科技工作岗位约占所有科技工作岗位的38%。

sentences.en: New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States.
sentences.cn: 新的人工智能技术尤其集中：布鲁金斯学会的马克·穆罗和刘思凡估计，仅15个城市就占了美国三分之二的人工智能资产和能力。

sentences.en: The dominance of a few cities in the invention and commercialization of AI means that geographical disparities in wealth will continue to soar.
sentences.cn: 少数城市在人工智能的开发和商业化方面的主导地位意味着财富的地域差异将继续急剧扩大。

words.meaning: n. 差异，不同（disparity 的复数）

sentences.en: Not only will this foster political and social unrest, but it could, as Coyle suggests, hold back the sorts of AI technologies needed for regional economies to grow.
sentences.cn: 这不仅会加剧政治和社会动荡，而且正如科伊尔所指出的那样，它可能会阻碍区域经济增长所需的各种人工智能技术的发展。

sentences.en: Part of the solution could lie in somehow loosening the stranglehold that Big Tech has on defining the AI agenda.
sentences.cn: 部分解决方案可能在于以某种方式削弱大型科技公司在定义人工智能议程方面的垄断地位。

words.meaning: v. 放松，削弱（loosen 的现在分词）
n. 束缚，压制性的控制

sentences.en: That will likely take increased federal funding for research independent of the tech giants.
sentences.cn: 这可能需要更多的联邦资金用于独立于科技巨头的研究。

words.meaning: n. 巨头，大公司（giant 的复数）

sentences.en: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.
sentences.cn: 一个更直接的对策是拓宽我们的数字想象力，构想人工智能技术不仅仅可以取代工作岗位，还可以在美国不同地区最关心的领域（如医疗保健、教育和制造业）扩大机会。

questions.stem: Coyle argues in her new book that economic growth should ___.
questions.stem_cn: 科伊尔在她的新书中认为，经济增长应该___。

options.D: be promoted forcefully

options_cn.C: 使人们平等受益

questions.explanation: 定位第一段首句：Coyle 在新书中认为，数字经济需要人们以新方式思考进步，且“收益必须比不久前被更加均衡地分配”。C 项 benefit people equally 正是对 the gains will have to be more evenly shared 的同义改写，故 C 正确。A 曲解“以新方式思考进步”为“催生新思想”；B、D 在文中均无依据。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 2, digital technologies should be used to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据第二段，数字技术应被用于___。

options.D: enhance cross-sector cooperation

options_cn.C: 提高整体工作效率

questions.explanation: 定位第二段首句：使更多人受益需要更多地使用数字技术来提高各个领域（含医疗、建筑）的生产效率。C 项 raise overall work efficiency 对应 boost productivity in various sectors，故 C 正确。A 将“提高生产率以带来繁荣”窜改为“即时繁荣”；B 无依据；D 把 various sectors 偷换为“跨部门合作”。

questions.stem: What does Coyle fear about transformative technologies?
questions.stem_cn: 科伊尔对变革性技术的担忧是什么？

options.B: They may be impractical to deploy.
options.D: They may be unwelcome to the public.

options_cn.A: 它们可能影响工作与生活的平衡。
options_cn.B: 运用它们可能是不切实际的。
options_cn.C: 它们可能会产生巨额支出。
options_cn.D: 它们可能不受公众欢迎。

questions.explanation: 定位第三段：Coyle 担心科技的不均衡问题会阻碍 AI 运用，并强调要做出“巨大改变”需要 social buy-in（社会认同）。可推知她担心变革性技术得不到社会认同、即不受公众欢迎，故 D 正确。A 偷换 inequality 为 work-life balance；B、C 均无依据。

questions.stem: Several American cities are mentioned to show ___.
questions.stem_cn: 文中提及几个美国城市是为了表明___。

options.A: the uneven distribution of AI technologies in the US
options.B: the disappointing prospect of tech jobs in the US
options.C: the fast progress of US regional economies
options.D: the increasing significance of US AI assets

options_cn.A: 人工智能技术在美国分布不均
options_cn.B: 美国科技工作的前景令人失望
options_cn.C: 美国区域经济的快速发展
options_cn.D: 美国人工智能资产日益重要

questions.explanation: 定位第五段：8 个城市占全美 38% 的科技岗位，仅 15 个城市占全美三分之二的 AI 资产与能力。举例意在说明 AI 技术高度集中于少数城市，即在美国分布不均，故 A 正确。B、C 无依据；D 将“资产集中”曲解为“资产日益重要”。

questions.stem: With regard to Coyle's concern, the author suggests ___.
questions.stem_cn: 关于科伊尔的担忧，作者建议___。

options.A: raising funds to start new AI projects
options.C: guarding against the side effects of AI
options.D: redefining the role of AI technologies

options_cn.A: 筹集资金启动新的人工智能项目
options_cn.B: 鼓励在人工智能研究方面的合作
options_cn.C: 防范人工智能的副作用
options_cn.D: 重新定义人工智能技术的作用

questions.explanation: 定位第七、八段：作者提出削弱大型科技公司对 AI 议程的垄断，并拓宽数字想象力，构想 AI 不只取代岗位、还能在各地关切领域扩大机会。这实为重新思考与定义 AI 技术的作用，故 D 正确。A 把“资助独立研究”曲解为“启动新项目”；B 将“独立于科技巨头的研究”偷换为“鼓励合作”；C 无依据。

articles.title: Confor Warns of Future Crisis in Wood Supply
articles.topic: 英国因植树不足面临未来木材与建筑业危机，政府新激励不足、长期投资缺位，呼吁加大对生产性植树的支持
articles.source: 2024 年考研英语（二）Text 2 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: The UK is facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood, Confor has warned.
sentences.cn: 英国林业贸易协会警告说，由于未能种植（足够的）树木生产木材，英国未来将面临建筑业危机。

words.meaning: v. 警告（warn 的过去式）

sentences.en: The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country's reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations.
sentences.cn: 该林业和木材贸易组织已呼吁采取紧急行动，以降低本国对木材进口的依赖，并为子孙后代提供稳定的木材供应。

sentences.en: Currently only 20 per cent of the UK's wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.
sentences.cn: 目前，英国所需的木材中只有20%是本国生产的，同时英国仍然是世界第二大木材净进口国。

words.meaning: adj. 本国生产的，本地种植的

sentences.en: Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government for landowners to grow more trees, the trade body says these don't go far enough and fail to promote the benefits of planting them to boost timber supplies.
sentences.cn: 在英国政府为鼓励土地所有者种植更多的树木而出台新的激励政策之际，该贸易组织表示，这些措施还远远不够且未能宣传种植树木能增加木材供应的益处。

words.meaning: n. 激励，奖励措施（incentive 的复数）
n. 土地所有者（landowner 的复数）

sentences.en: "Not only are we facing a carbon crisis now, but we will also be facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood," said Stuart Goodall, chief executive of Confor.
sentences.cn: 英国林业贸易协会的首席执行官斯图尔特·古多尔说：“我们不仅现在面临着碳危机，而且由于未能种植（足够的）树木生产木材，我们未来还将面临建筑业危机。”

sentences.en: "For decades we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply, leaving us exposed to fluctuating prices and fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises and our own supplies fall."
sentences.cn: “几十年来，我们没有承担起投资国内木材供应的责任，这使我们易受价格波动的影响，并且随着全球需求的增加和我们自身供应量的减少，我们还要争夺未来的木材供应。”

words.meaning: adj. 易受影响的，暴露的

sentences.en: The UK has ideal conditions for growing wood to build low-carbon homes and is a global leader in certifying that its forests are sustainably managed, Confor says.
sentences.cn: 英国林业贸易协会表示，英国拥有种植建设低碳住宅所需木材的理想条件，并且在森林可持续管理的认证方面处于全球领先地位。

words.meaning: v. 认证，证明（certify 的现在分词）

sentences.en: While around three quarters of Scottish homes are built from Scottish timber, the use of home-grown wood in England is only around 25 per cent.
sentences.cn: 约四分之三的苏格兰房屋是用苏格兰木材建造的，而英格兰本土木材的使用率仅为25%左右。

words.meaning: n. 四分之一（quarter 的复数）

sentences.en: The causes of the UK's current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels.
sentences.cn: 导致英国出现目前状况的原因很复杂，从对生产性林业的过时观念到灰松鼠对树木的大量破坏，不一而足。

words.meaning: n. 观念，看法（perception 的复数）
n. 大量毁灭，大批杀死

sentences.en: It also encompasses significant hesitation on behalf of farmers and other landowners to invest in longer-term planting projects.
sentences.cn: 其中也有一个原因是以农民和其他土地所有者为代表的人对投资较为长期的种植项目充满犹豫。

words.meaning: v. 包含，包括（encompass 的第三人称单数）

sentences.en: While productive tree planting can deliver real financial benefits to rural economies and contribute to the UK's net-zero strategy, the focus of government support continues to be on food production and the rewilding and planting of native woodland solely for biodiversity.
sentences.cn: 虽然生产性植树可以为农村经济带来实际的经济效益，也可以为英国的“净零”战略提供助力，但政府支持的重点仍然是粮食生产和仅出于对生物多样性的考虑而对原生林地进行的再野生化和种植。

sentences.en: Goodall added: "While food production and biodiversity health are clearly of critical importance, we need our land to also provide secure supplies of wood for construction, manufacturing and contribute to net zero."
sentences.cn: 古多尔补充说：“虽然粮食生产和生物多样性状况显然至关重要，但我们也需要土地来为建筑业和制造业提供稳定的木材供应，并为实现净零提供助力。”

words.meaning: adj. 至关重要的，关键的

sentences.en: While the UK government has stated its ambition for more tree planting, there has been little action on the ground.
sentences.cn: 虽然英国政府已经表明了种植更多树木的雄心，但几乎没有实际行动。

sentences.en: Confor is now calling for much greater impetus behind those aspirations to ensure we have enough wood to meet increasing demand.
sentences.cn: 英国林业贸易协会现在正呼吁为这些雄心提供更大的推动力，以确保我们有足够的木材来满足日益增长的需求。

words.meaning: n. 抱负，愿望（aspiration 的复数）

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 1 that the UK needs to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 由第一段可知，英国需要___。

options.D: lift its control on timber imports

options_cn.C: 降低其木材生产成本
options_cn.D: 撤销其对木材进口的控制

questions.explanation: 定位第一段：英国因植树不足将面临建筑业危机，需降低对进口木材的依赖；目前仅 20% 木材本国生产，且为世界第二大净进口国。可知英国需要增加国内木材供应，故 A 正确。B、C、D 均将“降低进口依赖”窜改，文中无依据。

questions.stem: According to Confor, the UK government's fresh incentives ___.
questions.stem_cn: 英国林业贸易协会认为英国政府的新激励政策___。

options.A: can hardly address a construction crisis
options.B: are believed to come at a wrong time
options.C: seem to be misleading for landowners
options.D: will be too costly to put into practice

options_cn.C: 对土地所有者来说似乎有误导性

questions.explanation: 定位第二段：协会指出政府新激励“远远不够”，且未能宣传植树增加木材供应的益处，并借 Goodall 之言强调植树不足将致未来建筑业危机。可推知协会认为新激励难以解决建筑业危机，故 A 正确。B 曲解 Coming at a time；C、D 均无依据。

questions.stem: The UK's exposure to fluctuating wood prices is a result of ___.
questions.stem_cn: 英国受木材价格波动影响的原因是___。

options.A: the government's inaction on timber imports
options.C: the competition among timber traders at home
options.D: wood producers' motive to maximise profits

options_cn.A: 政府对木材进口的不作为
options_cn.B: 对木材种植的投资不足
options_cn.C: 国内木材贸易商之间的竞争
options_cn.D: 木材生产商追求利润最大化的动机

questions.explanation: 定位第二段末句：几十年来未承担投资国内木材供应的责任，“这使我们易受价格波动的影响”。可知价格波动源于对种植木材的投资不足，故 B 正确（exposed 对应 exposure）。A 偷换为“对进口不作为”；C、D 均无依据。

questions.stem: Which of the following causes the shortage of wood supply in the UK?
questions.stem_cn: 下列哪项是造成英国木材供应短缺的原因？

options.C: Outdated technologies of the wood industry.
options.D: Farmers' unwillingness to plant trees.

options_cn.C: 木材业过时的技术。

questions.explanation: 定位第三段末句：原因还包括以农民和其他土地所有者为代表的人对投资较长期种植项目充满犹豫。可知农民不愿种树是木材供应短缺的一个原因，故 D 正确。A 无依据；B 与“英国有理想种植条件”相悖；C 将“过时的林业观念”偷换为“过时的技术”。

questions.stem: What does Goodall think the UK government should do?
questions.stem_cn: 古多尔认为英国政府应该如何做？

options.A: Subsidise the building of low-carbon homes.
options.B: Pay greater attention to boosting rural economies.
options.C: Provide more support for productive tree planting.
options.D: Give priority to pursuing its net-zero strategy.

options_cn.A: 为建设低碳住宅提供补贴。
options_cn.B: 更加注重促进农村经济发展。
options_cn.C: 为生产性植树提供更多支持。

questions.explanation: 定位第四段：生产性植树有益农村经济与净零战略，但政府支持重点仍在粮食生产和仅为生物多样性的再野生化；Goodall 强调也需土地为建筑、制造提供稳定木材供应。可推知他认为政府应更多支持生产性植树，故 C 正确。A、B、D 均非其主张或与文意不符。

articles.title: When Should Older Adults Stop Driving? It Depends.
articles.topic: 如何解决老年司机的安全驾驶问题：让危险的老年司机停驾很难，各方零散应对、缺乏统一研究；亲自续期与视力测试有效；自动驾驶无法解决撞车，应开发老年人易于驾驶的汽车
articles.source: 2024 年考研英语（二）Text 3 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: One of the biggest challenges in keeping unsafe aging drivers off the road is convincing them that it's time to turn over the keys.
sentences.cn: 让具有危险性的老年司机远离道路的最大挑战之一，是说服他们是时候交出钥匙了。

words.meaning: v. 说服，使信服（convince 的现在分词）

sentences.en: "It's a complete life-changer" when someone stops—or is forced to stop—driving, said former risk manager Anne M. Menke.
sentences.cn: 前风险经理安妮·M.门克说，当有人停止或被迫停止驾驶时，“（他们的）生活就会完全改变”。

words.meaning: v. 迫使，强迫（force 的过去分词）

sentences.en: "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored, it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles,'" Menke wrote.
sentences.cn: 门克写道：“美国医学协会建议医生，‘在有明显证据表明患者存在严重驾驶障碍、对患者和公共安全构成严重威胁，且医生提出的停止行使驾驶权的建议被忽视的情况下，通知机动车辆管理局是可取的，也是合乎道德的’。”

words.meaning: n. 特权，权利（privilege 的复数）

sentences.en: "Some states require physicians to report, others allow but do not mandate reports, while a few consider a report a breach of confidentiality.
sentences.cn: “一些州要求医生报告，另一些州允许但不强制报告，还有一些州认为报告行为违反了保密规定。

sentences.en: There could be liability and penalties if a physician does not act in accordance with state laws on reporting and confidentiality," she counseled.
sentences.cn: 如果医生不按照有关报告和保密的州法律行事，可能需要承担责任和面临处罚。”她忠告说。

words.meaning: n. 处罚，惩罚（penalty 的复数）

sentences.en: Part of the problem in keeping older drivers safe is that the difficulties are addressed piecemeal by different professions with different focuses, including gerontologists, highway administration officials, automotive engineers and others, said gerontologist Elizabeth Dugan.
sentences.cn: 老年学专家伊丽莎白·杜根说，保障老年司机安全的部分问题在于，其中的困难是由不同职业、有着不同关注重点的人——包括老年学专家、公路管理官员、汽车工程师等——零散地解决的。

words.meaning: n. 老年学专家（gerontologist 的复数）

sentences.en: "There's not a National Institute of Older Driver Studies," she said.
sentences.cn: “目前没有一个国家老年司机研究机构。”她说。

sentences.en: "We need better evidence on what makes drivers unsafe" and what can help, said Dugan.
sentences.cn: 杜根说：“我们需要更好的证据来证明是什么使司机具有危险性”，以及什么能有所帮助。

words.meaning: adj. 不安全的，有危险的

sentences.en: One thing that does seem to work is requiring drivers to report in person for license renewal.
sentences.cn: 有一个办法似乎确实有效，那就是要求司机亲自办理驾照续期。

sentences.en: Mandatory in-person renewal was associated with a 31 per cent reduction in fatal crashes involving drivers 85 or older, according to one study.
sentences.cn: 一项研究表明，强制性的亲自续期让85岁或85岁以上司机引发的致命车祸减少了31%。

words.meaning: n. 撞车，碰撞（crash 的复数）

sentences.en: Passing vision tests also produced a similar decline in fatal crashes for those drivers, although there appeared to be no benefit from combining the two.
sentences.cn: 通过视力测试（的要求）也使这些司机引发的致命车祸类似地减少了，尽管两者结合起来似乎没有任何额外好处。

words.meaning: v. 结合（combine 的现在分词）

sentences.en: Many older drivers don't see eye doctors or can't afford to.
sentences.cn: 许多老年司机不去看眼科医生，或者付不起看眼科医生的费用。

sentences.en: Primary care providers have their hands full and may not be able to follow through with patients who have trouble driving because they can't turn their heads or remember where they are going—or have gotten shorter and haven't changed their seat settings sufficiently to reach car pedals easily.
sentences.cn: 基础医疗提供者忙得不可开交，可能无法对驾驶有困难的患者跟进到底——这些患者因为不能转头或记不住要去哪里而驾驶困难，或者身高变矮却没有充分调整座椅设置，以至于无法轻松够到汽车踏板。

sentences.en: As long as there are other cars on the roads, self-driving cars won't solve the problems of crashes, said Dugan.
sentences.cn: 杜根说，只要道路上还有其他汽车，自动驾驶汽车就无法解决撞车问题。

sentences.en: Avoiding dangers posed by all those human drivers would require too many algorithms, she said.
sentences.cn: 她说，要避免所有这些人类司机带来的危险，需要的算法太多了。

words.meaning: v. 避免（avoid 的现在分词）

sentences.en: But we need to do more to improve safety, said Dugan.
sentences.cn: 但杜根说，我们需要做更多的工作来提高安全性。

sentences.en: "If we're going to have 100-year lives, we need cars that a 90-year-old can drive comfortably."
sentences.cn: “如果我们会活到100岁，我们就需要90岁老人可以舒适驾驶的汽车。”

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 1, keeping unsafe aging drivers off the road ___.
questions.stem_cn: 根据第一段，让具有危险性的老年司机远离道路___。

options.C: can be a tough task to complete
options.D: will be beneficial to their health

options_cn.B: 已成为一个有争议的问题
options_cn.C: 可能是一项难以完成的任务

questions.explanation: 定位第一段：让危险的老年司机停驾的最大挑战之一是说服他们交出钥匙，且门克指出停驾是“彻底改变人生”的事。可知让危险老年司机远离道路是一件难以完成的任务，故 C 正确。A、D 无依据；B 将“有难度”曲解为“有争议”。

questions.stem: The American Medical Association's advice ___.
questions.stem_cn: 美国医学协会的建议___。

options.D: has met with different responses

options_cn.C: 被广泛认为没有必要而不予理会

questions.explanation: 定位第二段：面对协会关于上报的建议，一些州要求医生上报，一些州允许但不强制，还有一些州认为上报违反保密规定。可知该建议得到了不同的回应，故 D 正确。A、B、C 均无依据。

questions.stem: According to Dugan, efforts to keep older drivers safe ___.
questions.stem_cn: 据杜根所说，让老年司机安全（驾驶）的努力___。

options.D: call for relevant legal support

options_cn.C: 已获得公众认可

questions.explanation: 定位第三段：杜根指出保障老年司机安全的困难是由不同职业的人零散地解决的，且没有专门的国家研究机构。可知这些零散努力需要好好协调，故 B 正确。A、C、D 均无依据。

questions.stem: Some older drivers have trouble driving because they tend to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 一些老年司机驾驶困难，因为他们往往___。

options.D: neglect car maintenance

options_cn.C: 受慢性疼痛困扰

questions.explanation: 定位第五段：这些患者驾驶困难，是因为他们不能转头、记不住要去哪里，或身高变矮却未充分调整座椅。其中“记不住要去哪里”对应记忆力减退，故 B 正确。A、C、D 均无依据。

questions.stem: Dugan thinks that the solution to the problems of crashes may lie in ___.
questions.stem_cn: 杜根认为，解决撞车问题的办法可能在于___。

options.D: adjusting the age limit for drivers

options_cn.B: 开发适合老年人的汽车
options_cn.C: 翻新交通设施

questions.explanation: 定位第六段：杜根认为自动驾驶汽车无法解决撞车问题，但需做更多来提高安全，并指出“如果我们会活到100岁，就需要90岁老人能舒适驾驶的汽车”。可知她认为解决之道在于开发适合老年人的汽车，故 B 正确。A 与其观点相悖；C、D 无依据。

articles.title: Protecting Consumer Health Data Privacy Beyond HIPAA
articles.topic: 健康类应用普及，但其收集的健康数据缺乏 HIPAA 等法律的同等保护；FTC 只能事后监管、面对海量新应用力不从心；联邦立法短期无望，加州等州已率先立法保护消费者健康数据
articles.source: 2024 年考研英语（二）Text 4 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: If you look at the apps on your phone, chances are you have at least one related to your health—and probably several.
sentences.cn: 你如果看一下自己手机上的应用程序，就很有可能会发现你至少有一个与健康有关的应用程序——还可能有几个。

sentences.en: Whether it is a mental health app, a fitness tracker, a connected health device or something else, many of us are taking advantage of this technology to keep better track of our health in some shape or form.
sentences.cn: 无论是心理健康应用程序、健身追踪器、联网健康设备还是其他类型的应用程序，我们中的许多人都在利用这项技术以某种形式更好地了解自己的健康状况。

sentences.en: Recent research from the Organization for the Review of Care and Health Applications found that 350,000 health apps were available on the market, 90,000 of which launched in 2020 alone.
sentences.cn: 护理和健康应用程序审查组织最近的研究发现，市场上有35万款健康类应用程序可供选择，其中仅2020年就推出了9万款。

words.meaning: v. 推出，发起（launch 的过去式）

sentences.en: While these apps have a great deal to offer, it is not always clear how the personal information we input is collected, safeguarded and shared online.
sentences.cn: 虽然这些应用程序提供了诸多好处，但我们输入的个人信息是如何被在线收集、保护和共享的，这一点并不总是很明了。

words.meaning: v. 保护（safeguard 的过去分词）

sentences.en: Existing health privacy law, such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, is primarily focused on the way hospitals, doctors' offices, clinics and insurance companies store health records online.
sentences.cn: 现行健康隐私法，如《健康保险可携性和责任法案》（HIPAA），主要关注医院、医生办公室、诊所和保险公司在线存储健康记录的方式。

words.meaning: n. 可携带性，可转移性

sentences.en: The health information these apps and health data tracking wearables are collecting typically does not receive the same legal protections.
sentences.cn: 这些应用程序和健康数据追踪可穿戴设备所收集的健康信息，通常没有得到同等的法律保护。

sentences.en: Without additional protections in place, companies may share (and potentially monetize) personal health information in a way consumers may not have authorized or anticipated.
sentences.cn: 在缺乏额外保护措施的情况下，公司可能会以消费者未授权或未曾预料的方式共享（并可能将其变现）个人健康信息。

words.meaning: v. 授权（authorize 的过去分词）
v. 预料，预期（anticipate 的过去分词）

sentences.en: In 2021, Flo Health faced a Federal Trade Commission (FTC) investigation.
sentences.cn: 2021年，Flo Health 面临联邦贸易委员会（FTC）的调查。

sentences.en: The FTC alleged in a complaint that "despite express privacy claims, the company took control of users' sensitive fertility data and shared it with third parties."
sentences.cn: 联邦贸易委员会在一份投诉中声称，“尽管该公司有明确的隐私声明，但它还是控制了用户敏感的生育数据，并与第三方进行了共享”。

words.meaning: v. 声称，指控（allege 的过去式）

sentences.en: Flo Health and the FTC settled the matter with a Consent Order requiring the company to get app users' express affirmative consent before sharing their health information as well as to instruct the third parties to delete the data they had obtained.
sentences.cn: Flo Health 和联邦贸易委员会以一项同意令解决了这一问题，该同意令要求该公司在共享应用程序用户的健康信息之前，获得用户明确肯定的同意，并要求该公司指示第三方删除其已获得的数据。

sentences.en: Section 5 of the FTC Act empowers the FTC to initiate enforcement action against unfair or deceptive acts, meaning the FTC can only act after the fact if a company's privacy practices are misleading or cause unjustified consumer harm.
sentences.cn: 《联邦贸易委员会法》第5条授权联邦贸易委员会对不公平或欺骗性行为采取执法行动，这意味着，如果一家公司对隐私的处理方式具有误导性或对消费者造成不正当伤害，联邦贸易委员会只能在事后采取行动。

words.meaning: v. 授权，使能够（empower 的第三人称单数）

sentences.en: While the FTC is doing what it can to ensure apps are keeping their promises to consumers around the handling of their sensitive health information, the rate at which these health apps are hitting the market demonstrates just how immense of a challenge this is.
sentences.cn: 尽管联邦贸易委员会正尽其所能确保应用程序在处理消费者敏感健康信息方面信守对消费者的承诺，但这些健康类应用程序涌入市场的速度表明，这是一个多么巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: As to the prospects for federal legislation, commentators suggest that comprehensive federal privacy legislation seems unlikely in the short term.
sentences.cn: 至于联邦立法的前景，评论员们认为，短期内出台全面的联邦隐私法规似乎不太可能。

sentences.en: States have begun implementing their own solutions to shore up protections for consumer-generated health data.
sentences.cn: 各州已开始实施自己的解决方案，以加强对消费者生成的健康数据的保护。

words.meaning: v. 实施，执行（implement 的现在分词）

sentences.en: California has been at the forefront of state privacy efforts with the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018.
sentences.cn: 加利福尼亚州凭借《2018加州消费者隐私法案》，一直处于州隐私保护工作的最前沿。

sentences.en: Virginia, Colorado and Utah have also recently passed state consumer data privacy legislation.
sentences.cn: 弗吉尼亚州、科罗拉多州和犹他州最近也通过了州消费者数据隐私法规。

words.meaning: v. 通过（法律等）（pass 的过去式）

questions.stem: The research findings are cited in Paragraph 1 to show ___.
questions.stem_cn: 第一段引用研究结果是为了表明___。

options.D: the advancement of technology

options_cn.A: 健康类应用程序的普遍性
options_cn.C: 智能手机的受欢迎程度

questions.explanation: 定位第一段：研究发现市场上有35万款健康类应用程序、仅2020年就推出9万款；结合首句“你手机上很可能至少有一个健康类应用”。引用该数据意在说明健康类应用程序数量庞大、极为普遍，故 A 正确。B、C、D 均非引用数据的目的。

questions.stem: What does the author imply about existing health privacy law?
questions.stem_cn: 关于现行健康隐私法，作者暗示了什么？

options.A: Its coverage needs to be extended.
options.D: It has disappointed insurance companies.

options_cn.C: 它阻止了医疗不端行为。

questions.explanation: 定位第二段：现行隐私法（如 HIPAA）主要针对医院、诊所、保险公司存储的健康记录，而应用程序和可穿戴设备收集的健康信息“通常得不到同等的法律保护”。可推知作者暗示该法覆盖范围需要扩大，故 A 正确。B、C、D 均无依据。

questions.stem: Before sharing its users' health information, Flo Health is required to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 在共享用户的健康信息之前，Flo Health 被要求___。

options.A: seek the approval of the FTC
options.D: obtain their explicit permission

options_cn.A: 寻求联邦贸易委员会的批准
options_cn.C: 删除无关的个人数据

questions.explanation: 定位第三段末句：同意令要求该公司在共享用户健康信息之前，获得用户“明确肯定的同意”（express affirmative consent）。D 项 obtain their explicit permission 正是其同义改写，故 D 正确。A、B、C 均曲解或无依据。

questions.stem: What challenge is the FTC currently faced with?
questions.stem_cn: 联邦贸易委员会目前面临什么挑战？

options.B: The rapid increase in new health apps.
options.C: The subtle deceptiveness of health apps.
options.D: The difficulty in assessing consumer harm.

options_cn.B: 新健康类应用程序的迅速增加。
options_cn.C: 健康类应用程序微妙的欺骗性。
options_cn.D: 评估消费者伤害的难度。

questions.explanation: 定位第四段：FTC 只能事后执法，尽力确保应用信守承诺，但“这些健康类应用程序涌入市场的速度表明这是一个多么巨大的挑战”。可知其面临的挑战是新健康类应用迅速增加，故 B 正确。A、C、D 均无依据。

questions.stem: It can be learned from the last paragraph that health data protection ___.
questions.stem_cn: 从最后一段可以得知，健康数据保护___。

options.A: has been embraced by health app developers
options.B: has been a focus of federal policy-making
options.D: has gained legislative support in some states

options_cn.A: 已被健康类应用程序开发者接受
options_cn.B: 一直是联邦政策制定的重点
options_cn.C: 在加利福尼亚州遭到反对
options_cn.D: 在一些州已获得立法支持

questions.explanation: 定位第五段：全面的联邦立法短期内不太可能，但各州已开始行动——加州率先立法，弗吉尼亚、科罗拉多、犹他等州最近也通过了州消费者数据隐私法规。可知健康数据保护在一些州已获得立法支持，故 D 正确。A、C 无依据；B 与“联邦立法短期无望”相悖。
